invented.quote: Nobody else is on the farm at that hour.
invented.why: The brief says Tomás runs the 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, not that nobody else is anywhere on the farm at that time.

invented.quote: If something goes wrong with a cow or the equipment, he decides what to do.
invented.why: The brief does not state what Tomás does or what authority he has if something goes wrong with a cow or the equipment.

invented.quote: In three years he has missed two shifts.
invented.why: The brief specifies that he missed two shifts "not counting those 5 weeks" he left when his father was sick, so saying he only missed two shifts in three years without that qualifier is inaccurate.

invented.quote: Nobody required this of him. He saw that the software could tell him something and he learned to read it.
invented.why: The brief only states that he learned the herd management software, not that he did so entirely on his own initiative without being required or trained to do so.
The brief only states that his written English is weaker than his spoken English, not that his spoken English is strong.
